text:
sasha: Heads-up — found a customer case where a streaming response gets client-truncated, the client retries, and the toolcall tokens seem to be billed twice. repro attached in logs below. Anyone seen this pattern?

ravi: Can you paste the raw router logs/snippets?

sasha: Sure — minimal logs: 
```
[router] recv stream init id=abc123 session=zz1
[router] toolcall fire tool_id=translate idempotency=null session=zz1 -> SUCCESS tokens=120
[client] connection closed (early-eof)
[client] retry streaming init session=zz1_reconnect
[router] resume stream session=zz1_reconnect -> route to same backend
[router] toolcall replay tool_id=translate session=zz1_reconnect -> SUCCESS tokens=120
```
Looks like the toolcall runs twice because the router treats the reconnect as a new session and doesn't dedupe.

maia: Hmm. Two things jumping out: 1) toolcall is not carrying an idempotency token so dedupe is hard. 2) our billing pipeline treats those token events as "confirmed" immediately on SUCCESS, even for mid-stream toolcalls that may later be replayed on reconnect.

leo: Could we make the router attach a provisional flag to any toolcall that occurs before the stream final-ack? Then billing only moves provisional->confirmed on final chunk ack (or session end). That avoids immediate double-charge.

ravi: That might work but introduces complexity — provisional credits need reconciliation if a backend dies and we never get final ack. Do we have TTL semantics?

maia: We do for provisional snapshots (we have a 5m tombstone today), but it's not wired into toolcall billing flow. Proposal: when toolcall happens mid-stream, emit billing event with status=PROVISIONAL and include session_id + toolcall_id. On final chunk (or stream close with final ack) emit CONFIRM referencing the toolcall_id. Billing pipeline should only invoice confirmed events and hold provisional ones for t=5m then drop.

leo: To make that robust, we should add X-Toolcall-Id header generated at client SDK (or router if absent) and pass it end-to-end. Example: `X-Toolcall-Id: 6b7f-...`. Router and backend must echo it in toolcall traces. Then dedupe/reconcile is deterministic.

ravi: I worry about backward compatibility — many customers already call tools without this header. Router-generated ids could help but then SDKs may collide. We should accept client-provided id else generate one. And dedupe should be local-first (router cache) then ledger-side-final.

ops-bot: Billing alert: account=acme-prod flagged for unexpected token spike (streaming_retries) — triggered rule stream_retry_spike_threshold.

maia: Console UX: we should show provisional vs confirmed token counts per request in the trace page. Right now traces just show tokens aggregated which hides provisional spikes. A small badge + tooltip can explain provisional -> confirmed lifecycle. I'll mock a quick patch for the request detail view.

leo: Dev plan items: 
- Router: attach/forward X-Toolcall-Id if present, else generate. TTL cache to dedupe exact toolcall ids within session window (30s).
- Billing pipeline: accept PROVISIONAL/CONFIRM events (schema bump), hold provisional for 5m before discard, and only bill on confirm. Backfill reconcile job for existing spikes.
- Console: add provisional tokens column in request traces + hover help.
- E2E tests: harness that simulates early-eof + reconnect + toolcall duplicate to ensure no double billing.

ravi: Also add an observability metric: `toolcall.provisional_count`, `toolcall.confirmed_count`, and `toolcall.dedupe_hits` so we can validate rollout impact.

sasha: Nice. Quick POC: router header example we can try now: 
```http
POST /v1/stream
X-Toolcall-Id: 6b7f-1a2b
Content-Type: application/json
{...}
```
If the backend returns the toolcall id in the tool response we can assert equality in logs and trace.

maia: I'll own the console mock and the billing schema PR. leo can you take router changes? ravi will add pipeline metric hooks and the reconcile job. Sasha — please attach the customer's full logs + account id to the ticket and I can coordinate with billing to pause any refunds until we have dedupe.

sasha: Yep, attached in the ticket now. Also noticed one more weirdness — the router's resume path rewrites session ids (zz1 -> zz1_reconnect). That kills simple string-match dedupe; we should carry original_session_id in metadata to make matching easier.

leo: Good call. We'll propagate `orig_session_id` header on resume.

ravi: Can we do a small compatibility-only rollout: router and billing read X-Toolcall-Id but keep logic off by default, then opt-in via a feature flag for accounts with incidents? Safer.

maia: Agreed. Feature-flag rollout and metric gating.

sasha: Thanks team. Quick checklist in thread so we don't lose it: 
- [ ] Router forward/generate X-Toolcall-Id + orig_session_id propagation (leo)
- [ ] Router dedupe TTL cache (leo)
- [ ] Billing schema provisional/confirm + hold-and-drop TTL (maia)
- [ ] Reconcile job for historical spikes (ravi)
- [ ] Console provisional token UX mock + PR (maia)
- [ ] Instrumentation: provisional/confirmed/dedupe metrics (ravi)
- [ ] E2E harness test (ravi+leo)

leo: I'll open an RFC draft in eng-platform and tag infra/billing.

sasha: :+1: thanks — will monitor the account and share any further anomalies.

ravi: :thinking: one more thought — we should also audit `toolcall.fire` paths from model adapters to ensure they don't silently retry internally. Could be another source of duplicate tokens.

maia: Good catch. Add to E2E checklist.

billing-bot: Note: created ticket BILL-3245 to hold provisional credits for acme-prod until CONFIRM events arrive.

sasha: Great. We can close this thread once RFC and initial patch set are posted.
